scope: Integrated preflight and actual publication paragraph-loss repair; no visual approval or change to source-loss refusal policy

residual_risks: Full repository race suite and pushed-commit CI remain separate gates; targeted internal/api invocation matched no tests and is not API behavior evidence.

resolved_scenarios: Nested children and aligned columns: derive largest joint group, then execute existing split primitive and compare every original string.
Flattened paragraphs or ellipsis counts: never infer source groups or budget from fitted text/counts.
Malformed/noncanonical numeric paths: no executable repair for invalid source identity, including +0, 00 and -0.
10,000-item indivisible group: linear boundary analysis rather than retrying all possible budgets.
Serialized CLI/MCP remedy: split_bullets and positive max_items retained through diagnostic action translation; execute serialized action without source loss.
Unsupported compound, empty, orphan, blank, unconverted or unequal source: manual continuation guidance, no destructive fix.
All fit modes and existing output: refusal remains nonzero and artifact-free; original input/destination preserved, fitting controls still publish.
residual_risks: A structural split is not proof of visual fit; every resulting page must be rendered and reviewed.
Numeric internal navigation and fixed slide counts still require explicit authoring/authorization; existing repair guards and continuation guidance remain in force.
